description: Record ID series per operation (DECISIONS D19).

fields.label: ID Prefix
fields.description: 2-8 capital letters or digits that start every record ID on this site, e.g. KLB or DDB. Keep it different from the other operation's site.

fields.label: How it works
fields.options:
Each record type gets the series in its row. {prefix} is replaced by the ID Prefix, .YYYY. by the year, and the counter (#####) is added if you leave it out. Counters restart each year.

Saving applies the rules straight away. Existing records keep their IDs; only new records use the new series. Untick Enabled to leave a record type as it is.

Walk-in patient identifiers are set separately, in EMR Registration Settings.
